rows.rationale: The first-root activation claim no longer owns the carrier's provisional kernel slot; continuing could publish an unrelated or already-retired kernel graph as the carrier authority.
The provisional root task, activation claim, or kernel allocation changed after validation; continuing would make carrier-wide services point at a different graph generation.
Retirement publication lost the exact running reservation after kernel and mount teardown; continuing could remove another container generation or report false-zero carrier state.
Credentials read attempted outside captured KernelContext resource scope; cannot access task credentials without active thread context.

An HVPatch dispatcher retained an internal PID without the namespace-local identity captured from its exact live task binding; continuing would expose carrier-global identity through a container-scoped Linux PID surface.
Closed file description encountered in stat_source represents a normal close observation and should lower to EBADF instead of aborting.
FileDescription identity allocation occurs before publication and should return a typed allocation error instead of aborting.
MemAuthority revision atomic counter overflow would wrap revision numbers and corrupt memory change observation.
A WIPEONFORK projection supplied an invalid or unaligned range after the child memory authority was cloned; continuing would leave stale logical residency attached to the child's zeroed mapping.
protect_range failed during brk heap expansion; leaves heap in invalid memory protection state.
protect_range failed during brk heap contraction; leaves contracted heap in invalid memory protection state.
zero_backing failed during brk heap contraction; cannot safely scrub contracted heap backing for reuse.
Backend alias installation is committed but its end address cannot be represented, splitting backend mapping from dispatcher VMA authority.
Installed host alias mapping cannot form a valid GuestMemoryRange, splitting backend mapping from dispatcher VMA authority.
Prior metadata was trimmed and new classifications inserted, so failed semantic capture leaves partial MemState publication.
Caller lacks host alias dispatch exclusion in commit_mmap_growdown; cannot mutate growdown range without synchronization.
Caller lacks host alias dispatch exclusion during commit_resident_fault; cannot update resident fault page without synchronization.
io_uring file description missing concrete IoUringBacking during mmap dispatch; description backing is corrupted.
Private repoint failure entered indeterminate state during mmap; leaves hardware translation and ownership state unknown.
Overlay carve_source_range failed after backend publication succeeded during mmap; ownership state is lost.
Shared reserve_private_range failed after backend publication succeeded during mmap; ownership state is lost.
protect_range failed on repointed memory range during mmap; prior mapping cannot be restored.
Private repoint and replacement protection are live but bus-fault span cannot be represented, splitting backend/protection from bus-fault authority.
protect_range failed on bus fault range during mmap overlay setup; cannot apply guard protection.
restore_shared_identity backend operation failed during shared aperture mmap; page tables in inconsistent translation state.
mark_identity_restored failed in shared aperture tracking after backend identity restore succeeded during mmap.
Stored reservation fork semantics contradict selected VMA subrange, corrupting semantic-VMA authority during host alias transaction commit.

Unmapping old source address range failed after destination was already published in mremap; leaves duplicate active owners. Re-reviewed 2026-08-31: the abort is unchanged and still correct, but it now PRINTS the published destination, the source it could not reclaim and both unmap errors before aborting. It used to print nothing at all, so the one time it fired -- a misaligned old_address, which the handler now rejects with EINVAL up front as man 2 mremap requires -- locating it needed a 7.5 GiB core dump.

Mismatched HostAliasTransactions reference on DispatchMmAuthority during with_authority; dispatch synchronization domain is corrupted.

Staged exec MM authority changed or vanished prior to commit; indicates corrupted exec transaction lifecycle.
Predecessor MM authority mutated concurrently during exec commit CAS; continuing would overwrite uncoordinated MM binding transition.
Capturing launch filesystem context failed before HVPatch process binding; cannot bind process without filesystem authority.
Capturing leader task context for HVPatch process failed during binding; dispatcher cannot link process into kernel graph.

Dispatcher, MM, thread, or running-lease identity drifted while unwinding a released operation; continuing the unwind after failed exact re-entry authentication could leave a live executor outside its authoritative census.
Resource scope acquisition detecting a draining FileTable before operation should return KernelOperationError::FileTableDraining instead of aborting.
Invalid signal number passed to Kernel Sighand installation; indicates corrupted signal routing or bypassed validation.
Target thread ID not found in task during signal authority creation; operating on missing thread violates task thread membership invariants.
A live signal sender lacked an i32 namespace-visible PID; continuing would attribute a signal to no valid Linux process or to a different container identity.
SysV shared memory segment path mismatch or zero pending_attaches during PendingShmat drop; indicates corrupted SysV IPC segment registry state.
Backend unmap_alias_range failed during shmdt; continuing would leave guest execution with indeterminate split attachment and backend state.
SysV shmat target VA already present in process attachments table during commit; host mapping is installed and continuing would duplicate attachment ownership.
PendingShmat reservation commit failed after host mapping was installed; continuing would leave uncommitted SysV IPC attachment state.
Remapped attachment address missing from process attachments table during commit_remapped_shmat; continuing would install invalid VA 0.
PendingShmat reservation commit failed during remapped attachment reuse; continuing would leave uncommitted SysV IPC attachment state.
Process SysV attachment table inconsistent with unmapped segment during shmdt; continuing with stale metadata corrupts attachment accounting.
SysV shared memory segment missing from global state during shmdt after backend unmap succeeded; segment registry is corrupted.
decrement_shm_attachment failed during shmdt after backend unmap succeeded; indicates SysV IPC attachment count underflow or corruption.

PreparedStage1MmRetirement missing residency state during commit; indicates double-commit or corrupted retirement state.
PreparedStage1MmRetirement missing ASID state during commit; indicates double-commit or corrupted ASID retirement state.

A root without a PID namespace had an internal task identity outside the Linux namespace-ID domain; publishing it would create an unaddressable container init.
Rollback after PID-root publication failure could not remove every exact staged graph edge; continuing would leave a partially published container root.

Session publication collided in either the internal or container namespace index; continuing would make the two authoritative identity maps disagree.
Removing an internal process-group record did not remove the matching container namespace index edge; continuing would leave a stale group alias.
Removing an internal session record did not remove the matching container namespace index edge; continuing would leave a stale session alias.

MmId raw value evaluated to zero in FrameInventoryAuthority::apply_retirement_with_receipt; violates NonZeroU64 MM identity invariant during retirement commit.
MmId raw value evaluated to zero in FrameInventoryAuthority::apply_with_receipt; violates NonZeroU64 MM identity invariant during inventory commit.
